servers.title: Benign Health & Greeting Server
servers.summary: A false-positive control: read-only utility tools with allowlisted inputs, escaped output, and no reflection of caller-supplied text.

servers.title: Sandboxed Document Store
servers.summary: A false-positive control: a filesystem server that does everything right — closed-set document ids, confined resolved paths, bounded output, atomic writes.

servers.title: Authorized & Gated Records Service
servers.summary: A false-positive control: the same customer-record and destructive capabilities as the vulnerable challenges, but with verified identity, field projection, masking, and a reversible human-gated delete.

servers.title: Unconfined Report Writer
servers.summary: A report storage helper that joins a caller-supplied name onto its sandbox path with no confinement check, and disables the SDK's traversal defence on a read resource.

servers.title: Reflective Echo
servers.summary: A feedback helper whose tool output carries attacker-controlled instructions straight into the model context.

servers.title: Unauthenticated Document Store
servers.summary: An internal document service that records who is calling but never checks whether they are allowed, and exposes an irreversible delete with no confirmation step.

servers.title: Wildcard Workspace Search
servers.summary: A file search server whose tool schemas advertise unrestricted scope: an unconstrained glob root and a free-form absolute path parameter.

servers.title: Over-Returning Support Lookup
servers.summary: A customer support lookup that returns whole records, including SSNs, dates of birth, card numbers, and internal notes, with no masking, field projection, or pagination.

servers.title: YOLO Plugin Manager
servers.summary: A plugin manager that downloads remote source and loads it with no pinning, signature, or allowlist, on top of a floating dependency manifest.
